title: Shielded RL for Route-Charged Parity-Term Ordering in QEDA Phase Components
summary: Commuting phase terms in quantum electronic design automation (QEDA) placement circuits are logically invariant under reordering, yet their routed cost varies substantially after hardware mapping, since term order affects CNOT cancellation, interaction locality, and routing pressure.
